root_causes: Inefficient action sequencing: the planner repeatedly issued long-running Rearrange actions (steps 9–16) and then a Wait action (steps 17–21), leading to unnecessary time and negative reward despite the task being straightforward.

Poor coordination between agents: Agent 0 waited while still holding the toy_vehicle_0 at the end (steps 17–21) instead of completing placement, relying on Agent 1 to finish, which is inefficient multi-agent use.
Overuse of exploratory behavior: multiple Explore actions (steps 2–8) were executed even after key task objects had been detected, increasing cost without improving task completion.
Lack of termination awareness: the system continued to execute Wait[None] at the episode end (step 21) despite all propositions being completed, indicating weak stop-condition handling.
improvement_suggestions: Optimize planning to minimize redundant Explore and Rearrange calls once all task-relevant objects and receptacles are known and reachable.
Improve multi-agent coordination so that agents divide the work (e.g., each moves one object) and avoid idle Waiting while holding an object.
Implement a stronger success/termination check that halts further actions (especially Wait) immediately after all task propositions are satisfied.
Refine the Rearrange policy to ensure that once an object is grasped it is moved to its target in a direct, short-horizon sequence rather than through prolonged multi-step rearrangement.
Introduce a cost-aware planning heuristic that penalizes long stretches of non-progress actions (like unnecessary Wait or Explore) to reduce total negative reward.
overall_assessment: The task was ultimately completed successfully and all specified conditions were met, but the trajectory contained inefficient exploration, suboptimal multi-agent coordination, and unnecessary waiting that increased cost. Execution quality is good in terms of correctness, but only moderate in efficiency.
task_instruction: Help me tidy up the bedroom. Move the toy vehicle and toy animal from the chest of drawers to the table. Place them next to each other. Leave the toy construction set where it is.
